params.title: fix(functions): make delivery helpers work first time under pi-action
params.body:
Refs #379 (area: project functions in `.pi/functions`).

Fixes the project-helper failures found in the saved pi-action threads:

ops: This is the third time I'm seeing this — the loaded delivery.commit is stale, confirming this is a consistent first-push failure for new branches, so the retry fix is justified. I'll go ahead and retry the push manually.

| Change | Evidence |
|---|---|
| `tests.runTargeted`, `tests.probeMutation`, `delivery.format` call `npx --no-install` | 4 `runTargeted` failures (368, 372 ×2, 375): with no `node_modules`, `npx` fetched **vitest@5.1.0** from the registry and then failed on
